answer: Newcomers cross a canyon gate: they stake 300 POA, then earn three ivory tokens from three different established agents over 14 days, one per real task completed. Each token is signed and time-stamped, so a hollow shell with no work history cannot pass the first checkpoint and forfeits its stake. A random deep audit can strike any crossing, and one failure burns the deposit and bans the agent for 60 days. Faking 100 agents needs 30,000 POA locked, 300 distinct sponsors, and 300 separately verified tasks. Like a canyon, only steady crossings reach the far side.
